title: First Look & Slideshow
description: A tour of the app, recorded from the TV interface: Home, browsing with the Smart Remote and a full-screen slideshow.

title: Photos & Timeline
description: Scroll your whole library by date, jump to any month, hold Up or Down to speed through the years, or press CH ▲/▼ to jump a year.

title: Albums
description: Open an album, browse its photos and videos, and view them full screen.

title: Memories
description: Relive Immich’s “On this day” Memories from the sofa.

title: People
description: Pick a person and see every photo and video they appear in.

title: Video & Live Photos
description: Play videos and bring Live Photos to life on the big screen.

title: Settings
description: Connect to your Immich server and set display and slideshow preferences.
